children: Sphere 3D completed a $5.0 million private placement of 1,666,661 units at $3.00 per unit, each consisting of one common share and a five-year warrant exercisable at $3.50. Affiliates, including the chairman and CEO, participated for $1.0 million. Investors are subject to a six-month lock-up, though warrants are immediately exercisable; full cash exercise could add about $5.8 million in proceeds. The company also agreed to file a Form S-3 within 181 days to register the resale of the shares and warrant shares, supporting investor liquidity after the lock-up.
